$comment: Public repositories the scan/diff benchmark runs against. Every commit is pinned so a rerun measures the same code. `base` is `head~50` on the default branch at the time the entry was added, which gives `aburi diff base..head` a real, non-trivial change set to project. Changing an entry is a documented event: the numbers in results/ are only comparable within one pin.
